test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Magnesium is not required at all for our body.
Calcium is the most abundant mineral in our body.
Sodium and chloride are required in huge amounts for our body.
Minerals are least important for our body.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcium is the most abundant mineral in our body.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 ​The **mineral calcium **is the most **prevalent mineral **in the **human body.**
 
 
• 
 **Calcium **is particularly **abundant **in teeth and bones .
 
 
• 
 The **remaining calcium **is found in the body **tissues**, **blood**, and the other **bodily fluids**.
 
 
• 
 One of the most **crucial minerals **for the human body is **calcium**.
 
 
• 
 It **aids **in **bone **and **tooth **maintenance** **and development .
 
 
• 
 Over a lifetime, a healthy calcium intake can aid in the prevention of **osteoporosis **.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• 
 Your body **benefits **from **calcium **for:

 
 
• **Establishing **healthy **teeth **and **bones.**
 
• Coagulating **blood.**
 
• **Transmission **and **reception **of **nerve signals**.
 
• Muscles **contracting **and **releasing**.
 
• Releasing **chemicals **and **hormones**.
 
• Maintaining a **regular heartbeat**.
